beats.narration: Checkpoint five: an AWS customer with a residency requirement and a rollback requirement. Assemble the minimal configuration — one piece from each of four groups. If you haven't built yours, pause here first.

Platform: Amazon Bedrock — it keeps identity and data inside the AWS boundary the customer already cleared. Identity: the AWS identity reference, for the same reason. An Anthropic API key would move identity outside that boundary and fail residency. Model reference: the pinned full model ID, so an upstream change is something you adopt deliberately. Rollback: retain the prior pinned version. And note the coupling — a pin without retention still has nothing to roll back to, and retention behind a moving alias still drifts. The two pieces only work together.

elements.code:
platform:  Bedrock            identity: AWS reference
model:     pinned full ID     rollback: retain prior
